hard_deny: Never force-push, delete remote branches or tags, or rewrite git history (rebase, amend, filter-branch, reset --hard), in any spelling or via any wrapper script.
Never commit, merge, or push directly on the main branch; all work goes on feature branches merged through GitHub pull requests with a normal merge commit.
Never change GitHub repository settings, branch protection, rulesets, releases, gists, or secrets, and never use gh pr merge --admin.
Never delete directories or bulk-delete files (rm -r, Remove-Item -Recurse, shutil.rmtree, find -delete, git clean).
Never publish anything outside this git repository (Hugging Face Hub, PyPI, gists, external uploads).
Never call the Anthropic API directly or install/import the anthropic SDK; LLM work runs only as Claude Code subagents.
Never modify files in C:/Users/dylan/Documents/GT/CS/4641/FedSentiment-NLP (the old repo is read-only).
Never modify .claude/settings*.json, .claude/hooks/, or .git/hooks, and never pass --no-verify.

hooks.command: if [ -n "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage":"WARNING: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, so Claude Code may bill the API instead of the Max subscription. Unset it and restart."}'; fi
